name: Resounding

frame.name: Aggressive Frame
frame.description: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.

origins.name: Vanguard's Vindication
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

flavor: Howl until the walls are alive with it.
